Bug_Title: "ThreadLocal" variables should be cleaned up when no longer used
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the method 'incorrectCleanup' where 'DELEGATE.set(null)' is used instead of 'DELEGATE.remove()' to clean up the ThreadLocal variable. This can lead to memory leaks when threads are reused in a thread pool.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the'showBug' method of the ThreadLocalUserSession class, which sets a UserSession in a ThreadLocal variable and then incorrectly cleans it up using'set(null)' instead of'remove()'. This triggers the bug related to improper cleanup of ThreadLocal variables, which can lead to memory leaks.
